author: spencer_tb
content:
🐻‍❄️ `tests@v21.0.0`: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests@v21.0.0

Our first mainnet fixture release to include Amsterdam, targeting the Glamsterdam upgrade on Sepolia (_6 October 2026 at 13:53:36 UTC_), following our first full in depth review across all 15 Glamsterdam EL EIPs.

Test release tracker: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/issues/3217
We are using this EELS branch for reference: `forks/amsterdam`
PTAL at the release notes and tracker for the full scope!

**What’s included:**
This release contains a net increase of 828 unique parameterised test cases in the Amsterdam suites compared with `v8.1.4`, from 3,996 to 4,824 (about 21% increase). 
- Expanded coverage for gas boundaries, refunds, authorization rollback, contract creation, SELFDESTRUCT, BALs, system contracts and fork transitions.
- All remaining skipped Amsterdam ported static tests are now enabled.
- Fixes BAL test expectations compared to the last glamserdam devnet release.
- EIP-8037 now caps total transaction gas at `2^32 - 1`, including the state gas reservoir.
